brief: Watches a security ledger on a cadence and raises an alert only when a detection starts or stops firing.
detail: A detection set judges when asked; the sentinel asks and turns the change of verdict into alerts. A detection is identified by its where text, so one account still under attack is not a new alert at each pass, and a returning attack, after a real clear, fires again. Each start records a case, a snapshot holding the finding, the ledger's head digest and the events nearest the firing; each start and clear is logged in the sentinel's own bounded log and announced on two process-wide event-bus channels. It runs three ways: Check on demand, Tick from any loop, or Cycle under an agent host. It reads the ledger and never writes into it. Test it on an in-memory ledger with invented events.
